records.claim: On eight fixed fresh tasks, terminal-only slate review gained 0.0553434 macro Span-F1 on the full denominator. All registered quality and validity non-degradation checks passed. All seven executed pairs had exact shared ancestry, one review call per arm, sole slate exposure, and 355–1,162 treatment-minus-control tokens.
limitations: One identity never reached a terminal candidate and contributes zero in both arms.
This is one fresh development canary, not replication or benchmark clearance.

records.claim: H57 did not guarantee a review fork. The Django prefix stopped with recycling.fresh-context-too-large after seven model calls and 30,177 model tokens, leaving both branches unstarted even though the trajectory contained one strongly task-overlapping pinned-base read candidate.
limitations: A forced pressure-boundary review has not yet been tested.
The candidate audit is gold-blind and does not assert relevance or score credit.
